# Decision: Use a shared cache layer

**Status:** Accepted
**Id:** dec-7f3a91
**Date:** 2026-03-04

## Context

How should read-heavy endpoints avoid repeating work?

## Decision

Reads go through a shared cache layer in front of the primary database.

statement: An identifier MUST be stable across an edit to any other part of the record; a record whose title is corrected retains its identifier.
note: One record, two revisions: a typo in the title is corrected and the rationale is expanded. The `Id` line is byte-identical in both. Node identity (REC-071) legitimately DIFFERS between these two revisions because the title is hashed; the record identifier legitimately does NOT. That is why the format carries both, and an implementation that derives one from the other fails one of these two fixtures.
